definitions.explanation: A detailed explanation or analysis of something, often by an expert.

examples.japanese: ⟦{専門家|せんもんか}→専門家：03088_senmonka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{試合|しあい}→試合：01601_shiai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{解説|かいせつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: An expert provided commentary on the match.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{本|ほん}→本：00111_hon⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{詳|くわ}しい→詳しい：02483_kuwashii⟧{解説|かいせつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ついている→付く：01960_tsuku⟧。
examples.english: This book comes with detailed explanations.

examples.japanese: ⟦{ニュース|にゅーす}→ニュース：04437_nyuusu⟧{解説|かいせつ}⟦{者|しゃ}→者：04662_sha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦わかりやすく→わかりやすい：09582_wakariyasui⟧⟦{説明|せつめい}→説明：01449_setsumei⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦くれた→くれる：00724_kureru⟧。
examples.english: The news commentator explained it in an easy-to-understand way.

notes:
{解説|かいせつ} implies expert or authoritative explanation, often used in media, academic, and professional contexts.

Common collocations:
- {解説|かいせつ}{者|しゃ} (commentator)
- {解説|かいせつ}{書|しょ} (commentary, explanatory book)
- {解説|かいせつ}を{加|くわ}える (to add commentary)
- {試合|しあい}の{解説|かいせつ} (match commentary)

Related terms:
- {説明|せつめい} (explanation - more general)
- コメンタリー (commentary - loanword)
- {注釈|ちゅうしゃく} (annotation, notes)
